components.css: .ds-button {font-family:var(--font);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;font-size:12px;background:#292136;border:1px solid #59456e;border-radius:5px;padding:13px 18px;color:#e1d1fb;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}.ds-button:hover{background:#362946;border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text)}.ds-button:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:6px; border-radius:2px; }

components.html: HomeProjectsAbout
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:var(--font);display:flex;gap:32px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.ds-nav a{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--accent)}.ds-nav [aria-current]{color:var(--text)}.ds-nav [aria-current]::after{content:"";width:4px;height:4px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%}.ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:6px; border-radius:2px; }

components.css: .ds-note{font-family:var(--font);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text)}.ds-note header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}.ds-note header span{color:var(--muted)}.ds-note pre{font-family:inherit;font-size:11px;line-height:2;padding:24px 20px 30px;overflow-x:auto;margin:0}.ds-note code{font-family:inherit}.ds-note a{border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:13px 20px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none}.ds-note a:hover{color:var(--accent)}.ds-note a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:6px; border-radius:2px; }

narrative.overview: A restrained developer portfolio with a dark canvas, lavender accents and JetBrains Mono throughout. The user-selected Sunny Patel reference informs the quiet navigation and generous separation; typography, real code and project evidence carry the personality.
keyCharacteristics: Flat charcoal surfaces with fine borders.
dos: Do retain JetBrains Mono and the standard cursor.
Do use lavender for meaningful emphasis and interactive links.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and respect reduced motion.
Do preserve the distinct editorial project covers.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glow or decorative shadows.
Don't turn project covers into invented product screenshots.
Don't replace the selected visual world with a new identity.
